projectName.title: Project Name
projectName.description: Enter a name for your project. This will be displayed in the UI and used for identification.

integrationMode.title: AI Integration Mode
integrationMode.description: How would you like your AI tools to connect to Backlog.md?

mcp.label: MCP Connector (Recommended)
mcp.description: For Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kiro, Cursor, etc. Agents learn the Backlog.md workflow through MCP tools, resources, and prompts.

cli.label: CLI Commands (Broader Compatibility)
cli.description: Agents will use Backlog.md by invoking CLI commands directly. Creates instruction files for various AI tools.

none.label: Skip for Now
none.description: Continue without setting up AI integration. You can configure this later.

mcpClients.title: MCP Client Setup
mcpClients.description: Select the AI tools you want to configure for MCP integration. The setup will run automatically.
mcpClients.selectAtLeastOne: 💡 Select at least one option to configure MCP integration, or go back to choose a different mode.

agentFiles.title: Agent Instruction Files
agentFiles.description: Select which instruction files to create for CLI-based AI tools.

agentsMd.label: AGENTS.md
agentsMd.description: Codex, Cursor, Zed, Warp, Aider, RooCode, etc.

installClaudeAgent.label: Install Claude Code Backlog.md Agent
installClaudeAgent.description: Adds configuration under .claude/agents/ for enhanced Claude Code integration

backlog.label: backlog/
backlog.description: Store tasks and config in backlog/

custom.label: Custom project-relative path
custom.descriptionTemplate: Use {{rootConfigPath}} as the project-root pointer file

customPath.label: Project-relative backlog directory
customPath.help: This path is stored in {{rootConfigPath}} and resolved from the project root.

folder.description: Store config inside the backlog folder

root.label: backlog.config.yml
root.description: Store config in the project root and point to the backlog folder there

checkActiveBranches.label: Check task states across branches
checkActiveBranches.description: Ensures accurate task tracking across branches

includeRemoteBranches.label: Include remote branches
includeRemoteBranches.description: Required for accessing tasks from remote repos

autoCommit.label: Auto-commit changes
autoCommit.description: Creates commits automatically after CLI changes

bypassGitHooks.label: Bypass git hooks
bypassGitHooks.description: Use --no-verify flag to skip pre-commit hooks

taskPrefix.label: Task prefix
taskPrefix.help: Letters only. Cannot be changed later. Examples: JIRA, BUG, ISSUE

editor.title: Editor
editor.help: Leave blank to use system default
